next_hypotheses_not_validated: Define lower-body locomotion around forward velocity, heading, actual sole clearance and support transfer, while exposing upper interventions during training.
Compare a lower controller with sufficient action authority against a bounded residual over the existing teacher; current short runs do not isolate capacity or saturation as the cause.
Any runtime contact/balance constraint needs explicit phase transitions; locking both feet can suppress locomotion.
Retain dynamic arm blend as a display candidate, separately from learned-head claims and without silently combining untested variants.
